title: Paloma Business Fee Schedule Footnote: SWIFT Fee Rebate on Upgrade Proration
content:
On a Paloma Business upgrade, the proration charge carries a SWIFT rebate decided by the SWIFT payout fees taken from the balance in the three months before the day the proration is settled, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day.

| SWIFT payout fees in the window | SWIFT rebate |
|---|---|
| 75.00 USD or more | 20 percent of their total |
| 40.00 USD up to 74.99 USD | 10 percent of their total |
| Below 40.00 USD | Not rebated |

As a clause: fees of 75.00 USD or more are rebated at 20 percent of their total; fees of 40.00 USD up to 74.99 USD at 10 percent of their total; smaller totals are not rebated; the SWIFT rebate is rounded half up to the cent.

The SWIFT rebate is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the proration charge; the charge after the deduction is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| SWIFT payout fees in the window | Rebate |
|---|---|
| Four fees of 24.99 USD, 99.96 USD | 20 percent: 19.992, rounded half up to 19.99 USD |
| Two fees of 24.99 USD, 49.98 USD | 10 percent: 4.998, rounded half up to 5.00 USD |
| 75.00 USD | 15.00 USD |
| 39.98 USD | Not rebated |

Only fees charged as SWIFT payout fees count; local-rail payout fees do not.
